about: Tags (#tag) and mentions (@name) the editor highlights, for each input, with the default tags() and mentions() and memos' Markdown options (breaks, no setext headings, math, footnotes).
`tags` and `mentions` list each match as written, in document order.

Expected results: the memos server's grammar (usememos/memos markdown/parser/tag.go and mention.go, at e051129) applied where GitHub's Markdown leaves text (CommonMark 0.31.2 where GitHub's 0.29 differs, decision D7), with Unicode cases following twitter-text's conformance file, except that only `#` starts a tag, not the full-width `＃` (Bob, 2026-10-16). Where the expected result differs from the memos server, `server` holds what the server gives and `why` says why.
A case marked `ambiguous` has no expected result: the references disagree.

Inputs come from twitter-text conformance/extract.yml (Apache-2.0), the memos server's tests, the memos web tests deleted in usememos/memos#6466, realistic memos inputs, and one case per Markdown context (`from`).
